chunks: Al-Saffar narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother al-Husayn, from his father 'Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام about madhy: does it invalidate wudu (ablution)? He said: If it is from desire, it invalidates.

key_terms.الْمَذْيِ: pre-seminal fluid being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.الْوُضُوءَ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification before salat (prayer)
key_terms.شَهْوَةٍ: sexual desire as the condition tied to the ruling

ai.seo_question: Does madhy invalidate wudu (ablution) in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning madhy and its effect on wudu (ablution). Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام states that when madhy occurs as a result of desire, it invalidates wudu (ablution), making the report relevant to ritual purity rulings.
